source: The Berklee Real Book (hand-copied), 'Everyday People' p. 133 and 'Fallin'' p. 134 — the owner's iPhone-scanned PDF 'The Berklee Real Book example examples' (22 pages, book pp. 120-141), pages 14 and 15, rendered with: pdftoppm -gray -f N -l N -scale-to-x 1500 -scale-to-y -1 -png <pdf> p (→ p-14.png, p-15.png).
